label: judgment
explanation: Two hard mandatory conditions from the description cannot be met. First, the description explicitly requires 'Native-level fluency in Japanese,' a language qualification absent from every field in Priya's profile. Second, the description requires 'extensive years of hands-on industry data science experience' for a Senior-level title, which exceeds the 3-year experience cap; this alone disqualifies the posting per CONTRACT.md D4§2. The location (Tokyo, Japan) combined with needs_sponsorship adds a further practical barrier. Relevant skills exist — Databricks and Unity Catalog (skills.data_bi) align with the Databricks platform preference, AWS (skills.database_cloud) matches the cloud deployment requirement, and LangGraph (skills.backend_automation) is adjacent to the LangChain/multi-agent requirement in the description — but no skill match can override the Japanese fluency and experience-cap blockers.
